paragraphs: SuperCom describes itself as a secure solutions integrator and technology provider for governments and other consumers facing organizations. Its offender products are grouped as a PureSecurity suite, which includes the PureTag RF bracelet for use across that suite. PureOne is a one-piece tracking bracelet for continuous location tracking of offenders both indoors and outdoors. The GPS Offender Tracking product is presented as alerting on tampering and out of zone activity and giving law enforcement the information it needs.

House Arrest is the home detention product, and it enforces scheduled and spontaneous biometric authentication while reducing the need for home visits. PureProtect is a smartphone app for victims that identifies and alerts of proximity violations. Inmate Monitoring reports zone-by-zone information on inmate movement at detention centers. SuperCom also supplies cloud-based software alongside the monitoring devices.

quote.text: House Arrest enforces scheduled and spontaneous biometric authentication and minimizes the need for home visits.
